nav.subtitle: Server settings
nav.overviewAbout: How the server looks and how it greets people.
nav.accessAbout: Who can join, and whether they apply first.
nav.ssoAbout: Members sign in through your organization's identity provider to join and to stay.
nav.joinFormAbout: Rules new members agree to before they talk, and what people answer when they apply.
nav.welcomeAbout: The banner, the welcome screen and the first steps new members take, previewed as you go.
nav.invitesAbout: Invite links that still work, and who made them.
nav.rolesAbout: Who can do what, ranked: colors, permissions and members for each role.
nav.channelsAbout: Order, categories, topics, slow mode, and who can see and use each.
nav.emojiAbout: The server's own emoji. Everyone here can use them as :name:.
nav.integrationsAbout: Agents, accounts programs drive, and webhooks, addresses other apps post messages to.
nav.sharedAbout: Channels shown in another server, or from one. Messages stay with the server the channel comes from.
nav.recordingsAbout: What recordings on the server keep: sound, or cameras and shared screens too.
nav.usageAbout: What the server holds, against its caps.
nav.limitsAbout: Caps for this server only, over the instance's defaults.
nav.applicationsAbout: People asking to join, with their answers.
nav.membersAbout: Roles, nicknames, time-outs, kicks and bans.
nav.automodAbout: Rules that catch messages as they're sent: blocked words, mention spam, links and a smart filter.
overview.name: Name
overview.iconHint: Square pictures work best. GIFs keep moving. Without one it's the server's initials.
overview.regionHint: Its messages, recordings and calls are kept there. An admin of this fuwa server can move it.
overview.joinMessagesHint: A hello in a channel whenever someone joins, so people can wave.
overview.defaultNotificationsHint: What members hear about until they pick for themselves.
overview.ownSettingHint: Each device decides, as it does everywhere else.
browse.hiddenHint: People join with an invite link.
access.whoCanJoinHint: Invite links work either way, for anyone allowed to make them.
access.inviteOnlyHint: Hidden from Browse. People join with an invite link.
access.anyoneHint: Listed in Browse for everyone on this fuwa server.
access.howInHint: Applications wait under Applications for anyone who can kick members. Set the questions under Rules & questions.
access.joinNowHint: Anyone who finds it or has an invite is in at once.
access.applyHint: People answer your questions and wait for someone to let them in.
access.dropped: Applications still waiting are dropped. Those people can join straight away instead.
access.linkedOnlyHint: Only people who sign in with waifu.dev can join or apply. Accounts made on this fuwa server can't. Members already here stay.
access.linkedUnavailable: This fuwa server doesn't offer waifu.dev sign-in, so nobody could join.
access.accountAgeHint: Accounts newer than this wait before they can join or apply, by invite or from Browse. It keeps throwaway accounts out during a raid.
access.gate.title: At the door
usage.allUsed: all {count} used: messages skip the smart filter until midnight UTC
usage.note: Limits are set by whoever runs this fuwa server. Self-hosted servers have none unless the operator adds them.
limits.intro: A cap that's off follows the instance default, which you can change in the instance settings.
danger.title: Delete {server}
danger.hint: Everyone loses access to its channels and messages. The server's operator keeps a copy of the file for a while, but you can't bring it back from here.
roles.intro: Higher roles outrank lower ones. Drag to rank them.
roles.pick: Pick a role to change it.
roles.lockedTitle: Ranked at or above your highest role
roles.locked: This role ranks at or above your highest role, so you can't change it.
roles.name: Role name
roles.colorHint: Members take the color of their highest role that has one.
roles.hoistHint: People with this role get their own group in the member list.
roles.mentionableHint: People who can mention everyone can always mention it.
roles.deleteHint: Everyone who has it loses it, and every channel forgets what it allowed.
roles.everyoneIntro: What every member can do, before their roles add more. Channels can still say otherwise.
roles.roleIntro: What people with this role can do, on top of @everyone. Channels can still say otherwise.
roles.notYoursHint: You can only give permissions you have
permission.administratorAbout: Every permission, in every channel, whatever a channel says. Still only over roles and people ranked below. Give it with care.
permission.manageServerAbout: Change the server's name, icon, description, AutoMod and welcome screen, and see its usage. AutoMod leaves them alone.
permission.manageRolesAbout: Create and edit roles ranked below their own and hand them out, with only the permissions they have.
permission.manageRolesChannel: Change who can do what in this channel.
permission.viewAuditLogAbout: Read the record of every change made in the server.
permission.changeNicknameAbout: Set their own nickname in this server.
permission.manageNicknamesAbout: Change the nicknames of people ranked below them.
permission.kickMembersAbout: Remove people ranked below them. They can join again.
permission.banMembersAbout: Remove people ranked below them for good, and lift bans.
permission.timeOutMembersAbout: Stop people ranked below them from talking for a while.
permission.manageChannelsAbout: Create, edit, move and delete channels. Also skips slow mode.
permission.manageChannelsChannel: Edit or delete this channel. Also skips its slow mode.
permission.viewChannelsAbout: See channels and read their messages, unless a channel says otherwise.
permission.viewChannelsChannel: See this channel and read its messages.
permission.sendMessagesAbout: Write in channels, and reply in threads.
permission.createThreadsAbout: Start a thread of replies under a message. Replying in a thread that's there needs Send messages.
permission.createThreadsChannel: Start a thread of replies under a message in this channel.
permission.createPollsAbout: Ask a question with answers people vote on. Anyone who can see the channel can vote.
permission.createPollsChannel: Ask a question in this channel with answers people vote on.
permission.attachFilesAbout: Upload files and pictures with their messages.
permission.mentionEveryoneAbout: Ping everyone with @everyone or @here, and any role, even ones that can't be mentioned.
permission.manageMessagesAbout: Delete other people's messages. Also skips slow mode.
permission.createInviteAbout: Make invite links that let people join, even when the server isn't in Browse.
permission.createInviteChannel: Make invite links that open this channel.
permission.manageEmojiAbout: Add, rename and delete the server's own emoji.
permission.speakAbout: Talk in voice channels. Without it they can join and listen.
permission.speakChannel: Talk in this voice channel. Without it they can join and listen.
permission.videoAbout: Turn their camera on and share their screen in voice channels.
permission.videoChannel: Turn their camera on and share their screen in this voice channel.
permission.recordAbout: Record voice channels on their device or on the server, and download and delete the server's recordings. People using fuwa see it and hear a beep; nothing can stop someone recording their speakers with other software.
permission.recordChannel: Record this voice channel on their device or on the server, and download and delete its recordings. People using fuwa see it and hear a beep; nothing can stop someone recording their speakers with other software.
permission.muteMembersAbout: Mute or deafen people ranked below them in voice channels, for everyone.
permission.muteMembersChannel: Mute or deafen people ranked below them in this voice channel.
permission.moveMembersAbout: Disconnect people ranked below them from voice channels.
permission.moveMembersChannel: Disconnect people ranked below them from this voice channel.
permission.manageWebhooksAbout: Make, change and delete webhooks, and see their addresses, which let other apps post in any channel.
channels.introArrange: Drag by the handle, into or out of categories, or focus it and use the arrow keys.
channels.introPick: Pick a channel to change who can see and use it.
channels.pick: Pick a channel to change it.
channels.topicHint: Shown at the top of the channel. Markdown works.
channels.slowmodeHint: How long members wait between messages. People who can manage messages or channels here don't wait.
channels.deleteCategoryHint: Its channels stay, outside any category.
channels.deleteChannelHint: Every message in it goes too, for everyone.
channels.deleteSystemHint: Every message in it goes too, for everyone. Join messages stop until you pick another channel for them.
channelPermissions.apart: Its own rules, apart from {category}. Its category's apply first.
channelPermissions.privateCategoryHint: Only the roles and people you pick see it and the channels that follow it.
channelPermissions.privateChannelHint: Only the roles and people you pick see it.
channelPermissions.nobodyYet: Nobody but the owner and administrators, for now.
channelPermissions.losingCategory: Saving this hides the category from you too. Add one of your roles to keep it.
channelPermissions.losingChannel: Saving this hides the channel from you too. Add one of your roles to keep it.
channelPermissions.advancedHint: Allow or deny each permission here for a role or a person. The rest follows their roles.
channelPermissions.notYours: You can only change permissions you have here
invites.everyone: Everyone's links are here. Revoke one and it stops letting people in right away.
invites.own: Only your own links show here.
invites.noneHint: Make one to let people in, even while the server stays out of Browse.
bans.noneHint: Everyone's welcome so far. Ban someone from the Members page or their profile card.
emoji.badType: Emoji are PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP or AVIF pictures.
emoji.drop: Drop pictures here, or pick some
emoji.dropHint: Several at once is fine. Each is shrunk to 128 pixels; GIFs keep moving. The file name becomes the emoji's name, and you can change it.
emoji.noneHint: Add the first and it shows up when people type a colon.
emoji.full: This server has all the emoji it can hold. Delete one to make room.
emoji.badName: Emoji names are 2 to 32 letters, digits and underscores.
ownership.intro: They get everything you can do now, including deleting the server. You stay on as an admin, and only they can hand it back.
audit.emptyHint: Changes to settings, channels and members show up here.
audit.s.recordVideoOn: {actor} turned on recording cameras and screens
audit.s.linkedOnlyOff: {actor} let in accounts made on this instance too
audit.s.anyAge: {actor} let in accounts of any age
audit.s.minAge: {actor} let in accounts once they're {duration} old
audit.s.channelPermissions: {actor} changed who can do what in {channel}
audit.s.automodTakedownIn: {automod} took down a message from {target} in {channel}
audit.s.webhookToken: {actor} gave a webhook in {channel} a new address
audit.s.sharedUpdate: {actor} changed what the other server's people may do in {channel}
audit.s.liveTileEnd: {actor} ended a live tile from {target} in {channel}
applications.waiting: {people} waiting, oldest first. They see the reason if you turn them down.
applications.noneHint: When people apply to join, they show up here with their answers.
applications.noneHintOff: People join straight away right now. Turn on Apply to join under Access to look people over first.
joinForm.starterKind: Be kind. No harassment, hate or slurs.
joinForm.starterSpam: No spam or self-promotion without asking.
joinForm.rulesHint: New members read these and agree before they can send messages. Markdown works. Drag to reorder.
joinForm.noRules: No rules: new members talk straight away. Start from one of these, or write your own.
joinForm.questionsHint: Asked when people apply to join. Whoever reviews applications reads the answers.
joinForm.notAsked: People join straight away right now, so nobody is asked these yet.
joinForm.question: Question {index}
joinForm.previewNoRules: No rules, so nothing to agree to.
welcome.emptyScreen: add a few words or a channel to the welcome screen first
welcome.bannerHint: Across the top of the welcome, applying and onboarding screens, invites and the server's Browse card.
welcome.screenHint: What new members see first: a few words and channels to start in.
welcome.onboardingHint: A few quick steps right after joining: what they're into, the rules, a hello.
welcome.accentHint: Tints buttons, progress and highlights on these screens. Picked from the banner, or your own.
welcome.emptyWelcome: Turn on the welcome screen to greet new members here.
welcome.emptyOnboarding: Add a step to onboard new members.
welcome.noQuestions: No questions yet: add them in Rules & questions.
welcomeScreen.enabledHint: New members see it once, with the rules to agree to when there are. With onboarding on, it's the last step. Anyone can open it again from the server menu.
welcomeScreen.wordsPlaceholder: What this place is about, and where to begin.
welcomeScreen.markdown: Markdown works on one line: {bold}, {italics}, links.
welcomeScreen.channelsHint: Up to {max}. Drag to reorder. People only see the ones they're allowed into.
onboarding.kindPickHint: Choices that hand out roles and suggest channels.
onboarding.kindRulesHint: Your rules, for people who haven't agreed yet. Never skippable.
onboarding.kindHelloHint: A message box ready to send in a channel you pick.
onboarding.enabledHint: Right after joining, people go through these steps, then land on the welcome screen. They can redo it from the server menu.
onboarding.stepsHint: Up to {max}, in order. Drag to reorder. Server rules show up for anyone who still has to agree, even without a rules step.
onboarding.title: Title
onboarding.skippableHint: People can go on without doing it.
onboarding.helloLabel: What the message box starts with
sso.usualWay: Anyone who can join gets in the usual way.
sso.yoursHint: Sign in through the provider to see that it works. It's also how you show you can before requiring it.
sso.saveFirst: Save first; signing in uses the saved provider.
sso.notYet: You haven't signed in through it yet.
sso.requireLabel: Members sign in with {name} to join and to stay
sso.signInYourselfFirst: Sign in through it yourself first, so you don't lock yourself out.
sso.requireHint: Members who haven't still belong, but see no channels until they sign in. The owner and agents never need to.
sso.recheckHint: How long a sign-in lasts. When it runs out, members sign in again to keep seeing the server.
recordings.title: What recordings keep
recordings.hint: For recordings on the server, which people with Record start in a voice channel. Recordings on someone's own device are always sound only.
recordings.soundHint: A track per person, as Ogg Opus.
recordings.videoHint: Each person's camera and shared screen too, as WebM files next to their sound.
recordings.videoOff: This instance doesn't let servers record video
recordings.videoOffHint: This instance doesn't let servers keep video in recordings. Whoever runs it can turn it on (Video in recordings, under Calls in its settings).
recordings.changedVideo: Everyone in the call sees “Recording with video”. Pictures take far more room than sound, against the same storage cap. A recording going on ends; the next, when someone presses Record, keeps video.
recordings.changedSound: A recording going on ends; the next, when someone presses Record, keeps sound only.
recordings.preview: An hour-long recording, for one person:
agents.intro: Accounts programs drive. They talk like members, with the roles you give them.
agents.none: No agents here yet. Make your own under {settings}.
agents.mcpFor: {name} can use this server through MCP
agents.mcpHint: AI apps such as Claude can use this server through the instance's MCP endpoint with an agent's token. This only decides MCP: what an agent can do here is still up to its roles.
agents.mcpWho: Agents that can use this server through MCP
webhooks.needChannel: Make a text channel first: webhooks post into one.
webhooks.title: Let other apps post here
webhooks.intro: Each webhook is an address that posts into one channel: build results, feeds, alerts. Anything that posts to Discord webhooks works too.
webhooks.noneHint: Make one, copy its address, and paste it into the app that should post.
webhooks.howToPost: Send a JSON {post} to the address. {content} is Markdown; {username} and {avatarUrl} change who it says it's from for that message; {embeds} work as on Discord. Add {wait} to get the message back.

webhooks.limits.one: Each webhook posts at most {count} message a minute, and never pings @everyone, @here or roles.
webhooks.limits.other: Each webhook posts at most {count} messages a minute, and never pings @everyone, @here or roles.

webhooks.reset: New address made. The old one stopped working.
webhooks.secret: Anyone with this address can post here, so share it only with the app that needs it.
sharedChannels.off: Sharing channels is turned off on this instance, so nothing new can be shared. Channels already shared keep working until either server ends them.
sharedChannels.nothingYetHint: Share one of your channels from its settings (Share tab), or add another server's channel with the code its admins give you.
sharedChannels.notCode: that doesn't look like a share code
sharedChannels.asked: Asked {server}. #{channel} shows up here once they approve.
sharedChannels.add: Add a channel from another server
sharedChannels.addHint: Paste the share code its admins gave you. You'll see where it leads before anything changes.
sharedChannels.approveNote: Their admins approve it before it shows up here.
sharedChannels.checkBeforeAsking: Before asking, check its key fingerprint with their admins somewhere you trust:
sharedChannels.storedOn: Messages are stored only on {server}. Your people's messages there are kept by them too, even if you disconnect later.
sharedChannels.storedOnIn: Messages are stored only on {server}, in {region}. Your people's messages there are kept by them too, even if you disconnect later.
sharedChannels.theirAutoModAlso: Their AutoMod also sends what's written there to {providers}.
sharedChannels.whatTheyCanDo: What your people can do there
sharedChannels.rolesNote: You decide which of your people see it with roles here. Pings to @everyone or roles never reach the other server.
sharedChannels.wantsToShow: wants to show {channel} in their server
sharedChannels.turnDownHint: #{channel} won't show up in their server. They can ask again with a new code.
sharedChannels.cancelHint: {server} won't see the request anymore. You can ask again with a new code.
sharedChannels.stopHint: It goes away from {server}. Everything said stays here, their people's messages included.
sharedChannels.removeHint: The channel goes away here. Everything said stays on {server}, your people's messages included.
sharedChannels.checkBeforeApproving: Before approving, check their key fingerprint with their admins somewhere you trust:
sharedChannels.yourAutoMod: Your AutoMod sends what's written there to {providers}, their people's messages included.
sharedChannels.theirAutoMod: Their AutoMod sends what's written there to {providers}, your people's messages included.
sharedChannels.approveTitle: Their people will be able to read the channel, past messages included
sharedChannels.comesFrom: This channel comes from {server}, where its messages are kept. You decide which of your people see it with this channel's permissions; they decide what your people may do there.
sharedChannels.worksForAnywhere: Works for {time}, for one server, here or on another instance.
sharedChannels.worksForHere: Works for {time}, for one server on this instance.
sharedChannels.elsewhere: For a server on another instance
sharedChannels.elsewhereHint: The code names this instance, so theirs can find it.
sharedChannels.shareHint: Give a share code to the other server's admins. They'll see this server's name, #{channel} and its topic, and what their people may do, then ask to connect. Nothing is shared until you approve. Once you do, their people can read everything said here, past messages included. Messages stay here.
sharedChannels.offShort: Sharing is turned off on this instance.
sharedChannels.onlyOne: A channel can be shared with one other server for now.
automod.kindKeywordsHint: Words and phrases you don't want said. Up to six lists, each with its own actions.
automod.kindMentionsHint: Messages that ping too many people or roles at once, the usual sign of a raid.
automod.kindLinksHint: Links to sites you haven't allowed. Allowing a site allows its subdomains too.
automod.kindSmartHint: A moderation service reads each message and says what kind it is: hate, harassment, scams, spam and more. You pick what happens for each.
automod.intro: AutoMod reads each message as it's sent or edited. Blocked words, mention spam and links are caught before anyone sees them; the Smart filter answers a moment after, and takes blocked messages down then. People who can manage the server are never caught, so test a rule with the box under it rather than in chat.
automod.noProvider: This instance hasn't turned on a moderation service yet. Its admins can, under Instance settings, Moderation: TypeSafe Jev and Cloudflare Clef take a key and one switch.
automod.providerOff: Provider turned off on this instance
automod.wordsHint: Matched whole, ignoring case. A {star} lets a word run on: {prefix} catches “bobcat”, {suffix} catches “catapult”.
automod.allowedAnywayHint: Words the list would catch that are fine, like “class” under *ass*.
automod.pingLimitHint: Each person or role counts once; @everyone and @here count as one together.
automod.allowedSitesHint: Every other link is caught. Leave it empty to catch them all.
automod.tryPlaceholderSmart: Write something it should flag or block, or let through. It goes to the provider.
automod.tryPlaceholder: Write something the rule should catch, or let through.
automod.noAnswer: The provider didn't answer: {error}. Messages go through this rule unchecked until it does; your other rules still apply.
automod.whenCaughtHint: Pick any. Without blocking, the message is still sent.
automod.blockHint: It never reaches the channel. Its author sees why.
automod.blockPlaceholder: What they're told (optional): “Keep it friendly, please.”
automod.alertHint: Posts what was caught, who said it and where, for your mods.
automod.timeOutHint: They can read but not talk for a while.
automod.leaveOutHint: Roles and channels this rule never looks at.
automod.providerHint: The services this instance's admins turned on.
automod.providerReads: {provider} reads the messages this rule checks, at {host}. It gets the text alone: never who wrote it, where, or this server's name, and mentions and custom emoji are swapped for placeholders first. Your instance sends it, never anyone's app.
automod.providerReadsPictures: {provider} reads the messages this rule checks, at {host}. It gets the text and pictures alone: never who wrote it, where, or this server's name, and mentions and custom emoji are swapped for placeholders first. Your instance sends it, never anyone's app.
automod.providerGone: This instance turned that provider off, so the rule lets every message through. Pick another, or ask the instance's admins.

automod.picturesHint.one: Up to {count} per message, attached or in embeds (PNG, JPEG or WebP). Your instance fetches them and sends them along; GIFs and very large photos are skipped.
automod.picturesHint.other: Up to {count} per message, attached or in embeds (PNG, JPEG or WebP). Your instance fetches them and sends them along; GIFs and very large photos are skipped.

automod.eachKind: What to do about each kind
automod.eachKindHint: Flags post to your alert channel and let the message through. The bar is how sure the provider must be. {reset}
automod.howSureAbout: How sure the provider must be about {label}
automod.alertFlagsHint: Flagged messages are posted here for your mods; blocked ones too.
automod.alertBlocksHint: Blocked messages are posted here too, if you pick one.
